events.title: Demo Update: Translation Improvements
events.summary: The Kuroi Pen demo's translations have been reviewed and refined.This update focuses on more natural dialogue, clearer wording, and consistent terminology in both the story and interface. Particular attention was given to preserving each character's voice and the intended meaning of the original text.Thank you for playing Kuroi Pen. Feedback on the updated translations is welcome.
